entities.name: Mạc Thái Tông
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mạc Thái Tông, known also by his given name Mạc Đăng Doanh, was the second emperor of the Mạc dynasty of Vietnam from 1530 to 1540. His father, Mạc Thái Tổ, was still alive during the first year of his reign and also reigning as “senior emperor”. His posthumous name is Văn hoàng đế, and his era name is Đại Chính.
